name: Harvard Ave Acquisition Corporation Rights that convert on a 1/10th of 1 basis to Class A ordinary Shares
summary: Harvard Ave Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 15, 2024 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
